findings.ac: Stress Cases: missing transitive reference makes build.py exit 1
findings.text: test_missing_cited_reference_is_a_fatal_build_error only calls build.closure_for() with a directly cited, missing file and asserts the SystemExit code is not 0/None. It never runs build.py as a process to assert status 1, never goes through emit_skill()/build_bundle(), and never exercises the transitive case (a reference that cites a further missing reference).

test_every_cited_reference_is_shipped_inside_the_skill only checks references cited from each SKILL.md body via build.cited_refs. References that cite other references (the transitive closure from closure_for) are not checked in the shipped dist/skills/<name>/references/, and the check does not apply the spec's relative-form requirement.

findings.ac: tests/install-harness passes 100% against the new canonical bundle
findings.text: tests/install-harness/run-L2.py still has an antigravity path built on the install-antigravity script and the old plugin layout. assert_tree's antigravity branch expects <plugin>/plugin.json and <plugin>/scripts/scaffold.py under .agents/plugins/stratosphere-os, and the antigravity-local and antigravity-global prompts were not updated. The bundle now puts scaffold.py only in dist/skills/stratosphere-setup/scripts and plugin.json in dist/antigravity/, so that cell cannot pass. Only L1 and the claude cells were migrated, and no test proves the harness passes as a whole.
